paragraphs.text: Abigale is an owlin bard -student at Strixhaven University on Arcavios . She joined Silverquill College.

Abigale is a serious and hardworking scholar, native to Arcavios. She is deaf and can conjure images and emotions in others' minds. After enrolling at Strixhaven, she received a Silverquill-designed hearing aid. This filters out ambient noise, relaying only intentional speech to Abigale. It also converts her sign language into telepathic messages that are broadcast into the minds of those around her. She is brown-feathered, has amber eyes, and features feathered crests at the sides of her head. She always moves with care, as she couldn't hear her own movement.

Abigale prefers to carefully observe the people around her and take time to compose her ideas thoughtfully and intentionally. Passionate and caring, Abigale is a strong advocate for others and excels at working behind the scenes, though she also has a judgmental streak, looking down on those who do not live up to her high standards for justice and fairness.

Abigale was born deaf in an owlin community that learned sign language. In her first year as a Strixhaven student, a Silverquill upperclassman designed a hearing aid to assist her communication. Though she intended to follow the Silverquill College study track, Abigale signed up for an Introduction to Magibotanical Environments class because it was a prerequisite for Advanced Floral Invocations. She also took a course on poisonous flora, although she dropped out of this class early after realizing Professor Dellian Fel 's harsh tutelage. Under the guidance of the teaching assistant, Dina , she visited Harrier's Wood, a forest some distance from the Strixhaven campus, to collect flowers. However, a faerie appeared and lured Abigale, along with her classmates Kirol , Sanar , and Tamira , through an Omenpath to Lorwyn-Shadowmoor .

Abigale and the other students realized that they had accidentally traveled to another plane. They emerged into a meadow containing a free-standing dolmen gate, which, paradoxically, opened into a cave on the other side. Inside, they found carvings depicting a pair of large, winged, six-armed creatures. One creature had a moon for its head; the other, a sun. They found the moon-headed creature, the elemental Isilu , in a chamber beyond the carvings and accidentally woke it. As they fled back through the dolmen gate, waves of darkness radiated from the beast and flooded the world beyond, turning the day to night.

Fleeing from the creature, the students found their way back to the clearing where they had started and spotted a patch of daylight with a person in it. Upon approach, the kithkin asked them what they were doing, and realized that they were from another plane. She introduced herself as Brigid Baeli . She explained the nature of the plane, mentioning that she had come to see whether there was a link between the Omenpaths and the unusual strangers that had been arriving on the plane since the Phyrexian Invasion . As she spoke, the students watched the night wash over the Omenpath they had emerged from and erase it. Realizing that they would be there for some time, Tamira asked Brigid if she knew anywhere they could stay, and the kithkin offered them hospitality.

Brigid brought the group to Goldmeadow , where they discussed their predicament. When Brigid heard that a faerie had been the reason for their arrival, she told them that they should seek audience with Maralen , queen of the faeries and a former companion of Brigid's. However, Isilu walked past the village, turning a place that had been in Lorwyn for years into Shadowmoor. Brigid told the students to escape before the xenophobic Shadowmoor kithkin attacked them, and they ran from the village, seeking Glen Elendra , Maralen's palace. When they arrived at the Wanderwine River , Abigale flew each of the others over, and they continued their journey. However, soon after they entered the Gilt-Leaf Wood , Kirol was kidnapped by an elven hunter, and none of the others noticed.

When the three remaining students realized that Kirol had disappeared, Abigale turned back to look for them, but was startled by a large elemental and fell into a tributary of the Wanderwine. Unable to swim out, she conjured a bubble of air and let herself be taken by the currents. She was carried downstream and encountered some merrows , who recognized that she had arrived in their waters due to the onset of the night and offered her their aid. The merrows brought her to the sleeping Eirdu , who smelled Isilu on her and woke. She led the elemental to its twin, and the balance between night and day was restored. After this, the students accompanied Ajani through another Omenpath, going from Lorwyn-Shadowmoor to Shandalar and eventually back to Arcavios. At Tamira's suggestion, Lluwen joined Strixhaven's cross-planar student program to escape the ruthless elven hierarchy of Lorwyn.

The following semester, Abigale joined Silverquill College, where she took a posting at the Forum of Amity to observe diplomats. Summoned by Lluwen along with her other friends to Titan's Grave, Abigale helped investigate the appearance of the Dawning Archaic , which had kidnapped Oracle Jadzi . Together, they were confronted by Chandra Nalaar , who believed that the disruption of the Archaics was due to the meddling of Jace Beleren . However, the Dawning Archaic returned, and in their efforts to fend it off, the students and planeswalkers fell into a chasm beneath Titan's Grave along with it.

Navigating the tunnels below the site, the students found the Dawning Archaic emitting waves of volatile, reality-warping magic, and Jadzi performing a ritual to calm it. However, the ritual was disrupted by Tam, who cast both Jadzi and herself into the nexus of wild magic, causing them both to disappear. With the chaos threatening to spiral out of control and kill them all, Lluwen was forced to finish the ritual himself, calling upon all his friends as well as the Lumarets to encase the Archaic in the force of their unity and stop its rampage.
